lifecycle.measured_path_scope: Measured cells launch the extracted original supervisor against already prepared private job fixtures; launcher and status reconciliation are exercised by correctness cases. Native MCP admission, registry/SSH transport, fixture preparation and post-run verification/report serialization are outside the measured path.
lifecycle.passed_definition: Declared correctness cases and all 128 measurement slots completed successfully; not a performance-superiority threshold.
lifecycle.resource_scope: Original supervisor raw wait4 rusage, separately recorded parent harness CPU, business self-rusage in original output, and bounded sampled owner/direct-child RSS; peak RSS is not a continuously observed concurrent-group maximum. Cell wall time includes task launch/collection and harness stdout/stderr synchronization; fixture preparation and report serialization are outside it.

rss_order_observation.interpretation: A43 occupies the middle ABBA rounds, while r07 includes the last round. Pooled maximum differences cannot independently establish A43 memory savings. The causal source of the sequence is unproven; no diagnostic rerun is included.

lifecycle.scope: Linux extracted original supervisor/launcher/status and synthetic local effects; not native MCP, SSH, multi-host, production adoption, reboot or power loss

publication_scope: Summary plus reviewed exact original evidence records; includes nonsecret path/stat/custody metadata, owned synthetic-fixture process samples and identifiers, and test/bootstrap Python snippets. No authentication credentials, private-key material, unrelated host-process inventories or compiled executable bytes were found in the reviewed contents. See the archive manifest for referenced but unbundled sidecars.
